paite: Huai khit in Toupa'n midang sawmsagih asep a, apaina ding kho teng leh mun teng ah, ama ah nihnih in asawl hi.
heading: Nungzui Sawmsagihte Sawlkhiakna / (Luk 9.3-5; Mat 11.22-23,25-27; 13.16-17)

paite: Akiang uah, "Buh lak ding atam mahmah a, himahleh asemte atawm uh, huchi in abuh la ding a sem dingte sawl ding in buh neipa kiang ah ngen un.
Pai un; ngai un, ngehon lak a belamnou bang in ka hon sawl ahi.
Dangka ip, kawlzal leh khedap tawi kei unla, lampi ah kuamah chibai buk kei un.
Huan inn na lutna peuh uah amasapen in, 'Hiai inn ah khamuanna tung hen!' chi un.
Huai inn a khamuanna ta a-omleh na khamuanna thu uh atung ah a-om ding a; a-om keileh na kiang uah ahong kik nawn ding hi.
Huai inn ah tung in om nilouh unla, ahon piak peuh uh ne in dawn un; nasemmi loh mu tak ahi. Inn teng ah ban hoh kei un.
Huan khua na lutna peuh uah hon kipahpih uleh, hon lui peuh uh na ne ding ua; huai a damlou omte leng na hihdam ding ua;
akiang uah, 'Pathian lalgam na kiang uah hong tungta,' na chi ding uh.
Khua na lutna peuh uah hon kipahpih kei uleh akongzing uah paikhia unla,
na kho leivui uh ka khepek ua bang teng na tung uah tatsiang ung e; himahleh Pathian lalgam ahong naita chih thei un, na chi ding uhi.
K'on hilh ahi, huai ni chiang in huai khuate thuak sang in Sodom khua thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding hi.
"Korazin, na tung agik e! Bethsaida, na tung agik e! Noumau a thillamdang kihihte Tura leh Sidon a hih hileh, sai-ip puan silh a vut lak a tu in akisik khin thamta ding uh.
heading: Kisik Nuam Lou Khopite / (Mat 11.20-24)

paite: Himahleh thukhen ni chiang in nou thuak sang in Tura leh Sidon khua thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding.
Huan nang Kapernaum, van tan ah tawisang in na om a, misikhua a sawnkhiak a om ding na hi.

"Kuapeuh na thu uh ngaikhia keimah thu ngaikhia ahi a; kuapeuh nou hon deih lou kei hon deih lou ahi; kuapeuh nou hon ngai lou kei hon ngai lou ahi a, kuapeuh kei hon ngai lou tuh hon sawlpa ngai lou ahi," achi hi.
Huan sawmsagihte kipaktak in ahong kik nawn ua, "Toupa, dawite nangawn na min ziak in ka thuthu un a-om uh," achi uhi.
heading: Sawmsagihte Kik Nawnna

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Khophia bang in van a kipan Setan hong kia ka mu hi.
Ngai un, gulte, aikamte sikdenna thu leh melma thilhihtheihna tengteng tung a thuneihna ka hon pia ahi; bangmah in ahon hih na kei hial ding.
Himahleh dawite na thuthu ua a-om ziak un kipak kei un; van a na min uh gelh ahih ziak in kipak zaw un,” achi hi.

Huai laitak in Jesu, Kha Siangthou in akipak mahmah a, "Pa aw, lei leh van Toupa, nang mipil leh mibengvakte kiang ah hiai thu na iim a, naungekte kiang a na than ziak in ka hon phat hi; ahi, Pa, huchibang hih nang ngaih in ahoih ahi.
heading: Jesu Kipahthu Genna / (Mat 11.25-27; 13.16-17)

paite: Ka Pa'n bangkim ahon kemsak a, Tapa kua ahia, Pa lou ngal kuamah in athei kei, Pa leng kua ahia, Tapa leh akiang ua Tapa in atheihsak nopnate kia lou ngal kuamah in athei kei," achi hi.
Huan nungzuite lam anga a, asim in, "Na thil muhte uh amu mitte ahampha e!
K'on chi ahi, zawlnei tampi leh kumpipa tampite'n leng na thil muhte uh muh akilawp gige ua, himahleh amu kei uh, bil a na zakte uh leng zak akilawp thei mahmah ua, himahleh aza kei uh," achi hi.
Huan ngai un dan thei mi kuahiam adingh a, amah ze-etna ding in, "Sinsakpa, tangtawn hinna neihna ding in bang ka hih dia?" achi hi.
heading: Samari Mihoih Gentehna

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Dan laibu ah bang gelh ahia? Bangchi in na sim a?" achi hi.

Huan ama'n, "Toupa, na Pathian na lungtang tengteng, na kha tengteng, na hatna tengteng, na lungsim tengteng in na it ding ahi; nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi, chih," chi in adawng hi.
Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Na dawng dik hi; huchi in hih lechin na hing ding,” achi hi.
Ama'n bel kisiamtansak ut in, Jesu kiang ah, "Ahihleh, ka inveng kua ahia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n adawng a, "Kuahiam Jerusalem a kipan Jeriko ah ahohsuk a, suamhatte atuak hi. Amau apuansilh asuahsak vek ua, avua ua, si dektak in apaisanta uhi.
Huan huai lampi ah siampu kuahiam ava paisuk a, amuhtak in lampi sik lehlam ah apel maimah hi.
Huan huchibang mah in Levi chimi khat leng huai mun ahong tung a, amuhtak in lampi sik lehlam ah apel maimah hi.
Himahleh, Samaria gam a mi kuahiam zin pai lai a-omna ahong tung a, amuhtak in alainat mahmah hi.
Akiang ah ava hoh a, aliamnate thau leh uain abuak a, atuam a, amah gan tung ah atuangsak a, khualbuk ah apaipih a, akemta hi.
Huan azing in makhai nih asuahkhia a, khualbuk kempa kiang ah apia a, amah na kem inla, hiai ban ana zat teng, ka hong kik nawn chiang in ka hon din ding," achi hi.
Huai mi thumte lak ah, suamhatte tuakpa a ding in, invengte hi pen kua hi in na gingta a? achi hi.
Ama'n, "Huai atung a zahngaihna suahpa," achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Nang leng huai mah bang in va hih in," achi hi.
Huan azin kawm un khua khat ah alut a; numei khat amin Martha in ana zintun hi.
heading: Martha Leh Mari

paite: Huai minu'n sanggam numei khat anei a, amin Mari ahi, huai minu Toupa khebul ah atu a, athu angaikhia hi.
Martha in bel nna sem in abuai mahmah a; huchi in akiang a hong pai in, "Toupa, ka sanggamnu'n kei kia nasem ding a hon khiat khawk sa lou na hi maw? Hon huh ding in sawl in,” achi hi.
Toupa'n, "Martha, Martha, thil tampi na ngaihtuah a, buai nei ve; thil khat kia akul ahi;
Mari in tan hoih atel a, huai laksak ding ahi kei," chi in adawng hi.
